verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs say its AI agent and MCP/CLI clients can 'analyze performance' and 'report on how your messages perform', and that automations have Goals (conversion criteria). They also describe scheduled recaps such as broadcast recaps and deliverability reports. None of this documents specific opens, clicks, unsubscribes and conversions metrics broken down per campaign and per automation step over time. missing for 10: documented per-campaign metrics (opens, clicks, unsubscribes, conversions), per-automation-step reporting, time-series/trend views, conversion attribution details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: report on how your messages perform
You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
It consists of four major components: Trigger... Goals... Exit criteria... Workflows
